title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Sakana AI + UC Berkeley publish MASS: a multi-agent system that acts as its own optimizer and evaluator, distilling collective agent work into self-supervision signals
bullets.summary: Published Oct 11; the official page reports better output-token efficiency on research benchmarks, aimed at tasks that are hard to verify (via ToolNavs briefing).
bullets.how: The Construct: relevant agent-architecture pattern for swarm self-evaluation, but self-graded signals conflict with the verify-from-raw-logs rule, so read the paper before borrowing anything. PRAGMA: talking point on self-improving agent loops and their verification limits. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: OpenAI raises default context for GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex and ChatGPT Work from 272k to 500k tokens (max 1M), with no long-context fees on subscriptions
bullets.summary: Announced Oct 11 by Thibault Sottiaux; context is user-adjustable (via ToolNavs briefing).
bullets.how: The Construct: benchmark against Claude 1M-context workers for long-running tasks and cost; no action until a cross-model eval exists. PRAGMA: pricing/context comparison point for client model selection. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: ElevenLabs launches Brand Kit in ElevenCreative: save logo, fonts and brand colors once and generated content applies them automatically
bullets.summary: Launched Oct 10 alongside a new Singapore office (via ToolNavs briefing).
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: could keep logo/colors consistent in generated video and voice marketing assets, worth a trial against the B9 brand palette. The Construct: pattern of a persistent brand context for generation agents. PRAGMA: client brand-consistency offer.

bullets.title: xAI's Grok Bot shopping: Musk says users can photograph a bank card and have Grok find the best price and place the order; OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux answered with an AI-generated fake card to show the risk
bullets.summary: Oct 10-11; xAI has published no formal description, and payment authorization, error liability and card-data handling are unexplained (via ToolNavs briefing).
bullets.how: The Construct: reinforces keeping payment and purchase actions behind a human approval gate and never passing card data through agents. PRAGMA: concrete governance example for agentic-commerce risk conversations. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

praxis_lesson: Agents that act (buy, self-grade, self-optimize) need an independent check outside the agent: payment steps behind a human gate and quality signals from raw logs, not the agent's own score.
